hardware: Intel Arrow Lake-P hybrid CPU, Intel graphics, NVIDIA RTX PRO 2000 Laptop
conditions: Same robot, RGB-D 640x480 at 30 simulated Hz, lasers 10 Hz, ros2_control 100 Hz. RTF measured from ROS /clock over wall time.
intel_sweep: First two samples compare camera 30 Hz vs 5 Hz at 1 ms. Runtime 2 ms change deactivated the controller; subsequent samples are diagnostic only, not valid controller-performance comparisons.
nvidia: Fresh headless full-house run at 1 ms, render device verified in Ogre log. No observed speedup.
2ms_gui: Fresh full-house RViz run at 2 ms. Condition label corrected against generated SDF. Later controller deactivation and failed motion check mean this setting was rejected.
table: Fresh table-only headless run at 1 ms; arm force/return and normal controller restoration passed.
table_nav_rviz: Table-only with RViz and Nav2 processes; lifecycle initialization stalled after a dropped service reply. RTF is an idle-process measurement, not proof of working navigation.
table_nav_nvidia: Table scene, 1 ms, RViz and active Nav2, NVIDIA renderer. 15-second sample overlapped a navigation goal. GUI displays could be changed interactively. RTF 0.778. Navigation outcome is recorded separately.
table_nav_fixed: Intel GPU, 1 ms, table scene, RViz and active Nav2 with look-ahead-point heading fix. Goal passed, 114 moving commands all within 30 degrees. RTF 0.660 over 15 wall seconds overlapping navigation. Earlier table navigation failures are retained as diagnostics.
house_nav_regression: Original house with look-ahead-point heading fix, 1 ms, headless. Goal passed: 0.098 m position error, 117 moving commands, zero outside 30 degrees.
